title: Runbook snapshot sampler and temporal alert resynthesis
author: Priya Nandakumar
description: Summary: Adds a compact runbook snapshot sampler and a temporal alert resynthesis pipeline to the slo-toolkit to reduce time-to-triage and enable deterministic rehearsal of noisy incidents. The snapshot sampler captures an ordered, token-limited representation of the runbook steps, key telemetry pointers, and contextual breadcrumbs at the moment an alert fires. The resynthesis component takes a window of raw alerts and produces a de-duplicated, temporally-consistent timeline optimized for human review and automated replay. Motivation: On-call responders frequently reconstruct incident timelines from disparate logs and alerts; this PR produces pre-assembled artifacts and synthetic replays so responders can make faster decisions and teams can rehearse previous incidents reliably. What changed: - New service: cmd/snapshot-sampler (Go) with a lightweight HTTP ingestion endpoint and an internal ring-buffer for short-lived samples. - New library: telemetry/snapshot (Go) - protobuf schema for RunbookSnapshot + compact pointers. - New CLI: rw-runbook sample [--rate=] [--ttl=] to produce and upload sample artifacts to S3-compatible storage or local store for on-prem installs. - Temporal resynthesis: telemetry/resynth (Go) implementing fingerprinting, temporal condensation, and probabilistic summarization; supports a deterministic mode for tests/replays. - Integrations: hooks to incident-bot (compact artifact links in PagerDuty/Slack messages) and a small adapter in slo-toolkit observability to surface sample coverage metrics. - Tests: unit tests for fingerprinting and condensation, integration test that runs a synthetic noisy alert stream through resynth and asserts condensed timeline matches golden fixture. - Docs: new runbook describing sampling guarantees, privacy considerations, and storage TTL semantics. Backwards compatibility: the sampler is opt-in; default sample_rate=0.02 (2%). Configuration flags added but default behavior is non-disruptive. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-10234) - [x] Protobuf schema reviewed - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Metrics and tracing hooks included - [x] Privacy and PII redaction pass - [x] CLI and installer changes smoke-tested Commits (high level): - Add initial snapshot protobuf and helper serializers - Implement snapshot-sampler service + CLI + config - Implement temporal resynthesis algorithm, add deterministic test mode - Add integration test harness and golden fixtures - Add tracing and metrics + dashboards dashboard:runbook-sampler - Fix flaky test by seeding RNG for deterministic mode - Add docs and release notes Files touched (high level): - cmd/snapshot-sampler/main.go - telemetry/snapshot/proto/runbook_snapshot.proto - telemetry/snapshot/serializer.go - telemetry/resynth/resynth.go - telemetry/resynth/resynth_test.go - cli/rw-runbook/main.go - docs/runbook-sampler.md - charts/slo-toolkit/templates/sampler-config.yaml - internal/telemetry/metrics.go - tests/integration/resynth_golden.json Review conversation snapshot: Marco Chen: "This looks promising — two asks: 1) default sample_rate seems high for large tenants, can we expose per-tenant override and a safety cap? 2) ensure snapshots never contain raw credentials or large blobs (DB connection strings)." Priya Nandakumar (author): "Agree on both. Added per-tenant override and global safety cap (configurable cap=0.1) in the second commit. Snapshots are bounded by a token limit and pass through a sanitizer that strips known secret patterns; added extra unit tests around redaction." Ava Morales: "Please add an opt-out policy so compliance customers can disable sampling entirely; also add a short retention matrix to the docs." Priya: "Done — cli + chart support an explicit enabled=false and docs include recommended retention tiers for SaaS/enterprise/on-prem." Evan Park: "Found a flaky timing assertion in the integration test on CI (races when background GC clears buffer). Recommend adding deterministic test mode or wait groups." Priya: "Fixed by adding deterministic mode that seeds RNGs and replaces time.Now() with a test clock in tests; re-ran CI." CI history: - Initial run: unit tests passed, integration failed (flaky resynth timing) - Fix pushed: deterministic mode + test clock - Rerun: all checks green - Final run: linters passed, integration/e2e passed, perf regression check within thresholds Merge: Squash merged by Ava Morales on 2025-02-02 (merge commit f3a9b7e2c6d). Changelog / Release notes: "Add runbook snapshot sampler and temporal alert resynthesis. New opt-in sampler produces compact incident artifacts and a resynthesis pipeline to condense noisy alert streams into a single human-friendly timeline; default sample rate is 2% with per-tenant overrides and an enterprise opt-out. Includes CLI, protobufs, and integration with incident-bot for quick links. No breaking changes; feature is opt-in." Operational notes & rollout plan: - Feature gated: rollout to alpha tenants by default in behind feature flag. - Observability: dashboards dashboard:runbook-sampler and alert rule runbook-sampler:sample-rate-drop are included. - Privacy: snapshots sanitized by default, KMS-backed redaction hook implemented for enterprise/private installs (configurable). - Rollback handler: sampler respects enabled=false and TTL expiry; to rollback simply disable flag and run sweep job to remove artifacts older than TTL. Known limitations: - Current condensation heuristics may over-collapse very dense correlated alert floods; a follow-up PR will add adjustable sensitivity tuning (ENG-10811). - Local on-prem installs require chart update to enable object store or set local-path storage. Follow-ups: ENG-10811 (sensitivity tuning), SRE-512 (cross-tenant cost monitoring), PM-311 (UX for incident replay), SECURITY-89 (audit of sanitizer patterns).

release_notes: New opt-in runbook snapshot sampler and temporal resynthesis pipeline. Default sample_rate=2% with per-tenant overrides and enterprise opt-out. Includes CLI, protobuf snapshot format, integration with incident-bot for quick links, dashboards for sample coverage, and privacy-aware sanitization. No breaking changes.
notes_for_oncall: If a tenant reports unexpected artifacts, check sampler.enabled and sampler.per_tenant_overrides; run maintenance script bin/sampler-cleanup --ttl to purge artifacts. Dashboards: dashboard:runbook-sampler and alert rule runbook-sampler:sample-rate-drop. For PII concerns, verify sanitizer rules in config and consult SECURITY-89 for update cadence.
